beamngEarth_devToggle.title: BeamNG.Earth: toggle dev overlays
beamngEarth_devToggle.desc: Turns the last-used BeamNG.Earth dev tools preset on (default: LOD), or everything off. Unbound by default.

beamngEarth_wireframe.title: BeamNG.Earth: wireframe view
beamngEarth_wireframe.desc: Shows the world as triangle edges (how the ground, the far terrain and the roads are built), or turns it off again (Ctrl+Alt+W).

beamngEarth_reportNote.title: BeamNG.Earth: report an issue / idea
beamngEarth_reportNote.desc: Captures a screenshot, the location, the performance and your hardware now, and opens a window to describe a map issue, performance issue, bug or idea; saves a ready-to-post GitHub issue (Ctrl+Shift+E).

beamngEarth_reportBench.title: BeamNG.Earth: performance profiler (30 s)
beamngEarth_reportBench.desc: Records 30 s of frame times while you drive, then opens the report window for a performance issue (Ctrl+Shift+Y).

beamngEarth_nearestStation.title: BeamNG.Earth: route to the nearest station
beamngEarth_nearestStation.desc: Sets the GPS to the nearest gas station, or the nearest EV charger for an electric car (Ctrl+Shift+Q). The low fuel prompt names this key.

beamngEarth_mapToggle.title: BeamNG.Earth: world map
beamngEarth_mapToggle.desc: Opens the BeamNG.Earth world map (where you are, saved places, click to teleport), or closes it. In our level the game's map key (M) and the pause menu's Map open it; unbound by default (bind a key here if you like).

beamngEarth_map3dToggle.title: BeamNG.Earth: 3D map
beamngEarth_map3dToggle.desc: Flies the camera up from the car into the 3D map (move with WASD or the left stick, turn and tilt with the mouse or the right stick, zoom with the wheel), or back down to the car. Unbound by default; the map key opens it when Settings > Interface > Map style is 3D.

beamngEarth_airTrafficToggle.title: Live air traffic: on / off
beamngEarth_airTrafficToggle.desc: Shows or hides the real aircraft round you (Ctrl+Alt+A). The first time it points to the settings page, which says what is sent and to whom before it is turned on.

beamngEarth_airTrafficLabels.title: Live air traffic: labels (full / flight number / type / off)
beamngEarth_airTrafficLabels.desc: Cycles the labels over real aircraft (Ctrl+Alt+K).

beamngEarth_airTrafficContrails.title: Live air traffic: contrails on / off
beamngEarth_airTrafficContrails.desc: Shows or hides the contrails behind high-flying jets (Ctrl+Alt+C).

beamngEarth_airTrafficIdentify.title: Live air traffic: what is that plane?
beamngEarth_airTrafficIdentify.desc: The flight, type, registration, altitude, speed and destination of the aircraft nearest the middle of the screen (Ctrl+Alt+I).

beamngEarth_airTrafficSounds.title: Live air traffic: aircraft sounds on / off
beamngEarth_airTrafficSounds.desc: Turns the sounds of nearby aircraft on or off (Ctrl+Alt+S).

beamngEarth_airTrafficFollow.title: Live air traffic: follow an aircraft / sit inside it
beamngEarth_airTrafficFollow.desc: Once: the camera follows the aircraft nearest the middle of the screen. Again: sit inside it and look around with the mouse. A third time: the camera back (Ctrl+Alt+F).
